day.headline: A Pig day — Rabbit and Goat are in step.

reasons: Rabbit and Pig share a triad — strong alignment today
signs.motif: the last of the good bread
signs.message: One loaf left at the counter. Take it, eat it warm.

reasons: Rat sits apart from Pig — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: A Monday that didn't fight you. Push your luck a little.

reasons: Horse sits apart from Pig — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Second one's supposed to be bad. Watch it tonight anyway, loudly.

reasons: Ox sits apart from Pig — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: a table booked for the wrong day
signs.message: Wrong date on the reservation. Call, move it, they'll figure something out.

reasons: Pig's own day — your energy runs high
signs.message: You've said maybe three times now. Make it a no.

reasons: Dragon sits apart from Pig — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Fourth one this year. Leave it by the door, not your bag.

reasons: Tiger pairs with Pig — a harmonious day
signs.message: Those soles are gone. Wear them out one last day.

reasons: Snake opposes Pig — a day to take slowly
signs.message: Still open from Monday. Read it or close it, pick one.

reasons: Goat and Pig share a triad — strong alignment today
signs.message: You haven't worn it since high school. Bag it, no ceremony.

reasons: Rooster sits apart from Pig — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Two people swear by it. Nothing says today's the day.

reasons: Dog sits apart from Pig — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Nothing in that cart needs you. Let it sit longer.

reasons: Monkey sits apart from Pig — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: It worked once in March. Don't audition it again tonight.
